summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, a social hub, lore destinations and a solo tutorial. Shared player behaviors and place simulations compose authored and generated spaces; the LAGSCOPE mod samples local performance and turns reports into actionable, file-aware briefs.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, routes and generated landmarks including Level 0.2, Zenith entry, north-rim Christmas Area, seeded Manila Room and stair anomalies.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops/escalators and simulated staff; Rico's platform routine and Bonus Line boarding cooperate.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.

places/level1, level2, level02, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Level 0.2, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; local sims own specialized environments and routes.

places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level10, level26, level27 (3D) - Office, Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender and entities 20 and 720 (Tiny), Bumper Crop farm/outpost and lake, and deeper destinations.

places/level11, places/level12, places/level13 (3D) - Infinite City and Matrix-to-Boiling-Frogs destinations; Level 13 has Floor 283 reception, numbered halls, furnished/story-bearing flats, residents, foes and B8 tape.
places/testlab + places/spamton (3D) - authored test and bonus spaces; places/level184 is another standalone simulated destination.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival and tutorial routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - Level 0 layout, Christmas Area pocket and stair-anomaly seeding.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/level0-moments.js + scripts/moments.js - seeded Level 0 story spaces and usable-object handlers, including Manila Room stairs.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js + scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - Level 0.2 house, crew exit, basement grid/collapse and Fresh Paint.
mods/lagscope/mod.json + watch.js + panel.js - attach-to-player performance sampling and F3/god-rail inspector in any game with the mod installed.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/names, destinations and door/model proximity-preload manifest.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js and scripts/lib/sign-style.js + scripts/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/id generated sign boards.

scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + scripts/lib/data/l02-remodel.yml + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - Level 0.2 prop catalog, shifting partitions, lamp/paint configuration, crew dressing and reset.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - shared prop/wall material, damage, drops, wrecking and regrowth; place sims opt in with sweepProps/tickWalls.
mods/lagscope/lib/{watch,scene,probe,brief,store}.js - mod-wide local sampling, game-thread probe, analysis brief and SQL reports reused by its panel and builder/report commands.

flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics and weaponAim; player.js zoneHere → scripts/lib/maze.js zone names.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state; Bonus Line boarding is separate.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time; hub UI routes Bonus/home destinations.
places/main/sim.js cadence → layXmas(ctx) → scripts/lib/data/xmas.yml + scripts/xmas-geo.js populate the north-rim Christmas pocket; xmas.yml bounds also let player.js suppress Level 0 hum.

xmas-room.js attaches scripts/xmas-still.js to Still Lifes, Lamp Sitter, Watcher and Red Stray → role-specific movement/combat and searchable container state; Christmas loot flows into player inventory and crafting.
scripts/lib/data/craft.yml + scripts/lib/craft.js → Bobette and Carolynne recipes; weapons.yml, weapon-look.js, vmpose.js and art/weapons/fit.json define combat weapon variants and presentation.

places/main/sim.js → scripts/lib/level0-moments.js seeded Harris/Manila Room + sealed perimeter/stair door and return trigger → scripts/moments.js plays stair sound/flash and transfers the interacting player between outside and downstairs.

scripts/player.js uses musicbox token → scripts/lib/musicbox.js places a wind-up box after rest cooldown, kneels and starts audio/effects → scripts/musicbox.js winds down and E pickup restores the token; musicNear queries within range.
scripts/interact.js loot search → loot.gateItems → items/weapons roll; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; focus → player.state.focus → loot/talk/shop UI.

mods/lagscope/mod.json attaches watch.js to each player and god.js to god mode → local watch samples scene, page and game-thread probe; lagscope:scan ear requests a fresh manual scan → brief.js composes AI-readable culprit/files/fix eviden…

places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts - Zenith Station environment and interactive systems; places/level02/sim.js + l02-grid.js vary basement partitions, lights, crew, knocks and reset.

scripts/lib/breakables.js + participating place sims - explicit/tagged and ID-classified props share damage/material/drop/regrowth behavior; per-place wall systems and tailored prop sets vary across levels.

migrationNotes: Threshold dressing version is V=7 in scripts/lib/thresholds.js; preserve thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV and door transfers' local #-marked xferTo/carryId rules; Bonus and room/world destinations do not carry held objects.

Level 3 hatchV=3 rebuild destroys old l3-hatch-* objects; hatchAt deterministically shares each wall's door across its two faces. Level 3 lineV=2 replaces legacy line-model instances with three Tripo stations and animated belt boxes.

Level 0.2 sim V=25 rebuilds generated roots; preserve phase/caseLandAt and debris tags, plus the 15-second empty reset. Grid state remains place.state.l02grid={layout, lamps}; walls swap on six-second passes with view/near/lamp exclusions.

Christmas Area scripts/lib/data/xmas.yml v=9 re-lays xmas-prefixed objects; keep maze.js XMAS_CELL and xmas.yml cell/bounds aligned (bounds suppress Level 0 hum); retain top-level player.state baubles/stuffing for craft recipes.
